result.summary:
P22 is done on its own files: the 5 red cases are green in every run since the restart except one case during a temporary edit by P23 (withdrawn since). The P22 guard batch still shows 2 reds on the current tree; both come from P23's in-progress edits, not from P22 (details in openIssues).

**What the previous agent's draft already fixed (kept as is, re-read and verified):**
- **law.interpelle-joueur (board while escorting):** `withDetainee(a)` in `ops-arrest.ts`, used in `special.ts startEmbark` and `system.ts drive`. An agent in charge of a detainee is not seated by an embark order; he boards after the handover.
- **nasse-sortie-filtree seeds 23 and 5:** the called van was declared "stalled" after 12 s because its first remaining-route reading was 0. `findHandover` now starts `vanBest` at Infinity and `arrest-service.remaining` falls back to straight-line distance until the autopilot has a route. All 9 seeds now end with 4 of 4 culprits in custody and 0 leaks.
- **bravm.ordres-joueur T5:** after the offender has fled once and stopped, the pair approaches at a walk inside 26 m instead of running, which the crowd reads as a charge. Measured: pair on him at t+40 s, arrested at t+57.5 s.
- **ui-command.envoi-fiche nasse:** the test now forces a scene refresh at each step. The loop bound, exit condition and assertions are unchanged, so nothing is weakened. I measured that without it the scene refreshes on the wall clock (about every 5 iterations) and the loop missed the one step where two exits were held.

**What I added this session:**
- **`pushThrough` in `transfer/system.ts`:** a cellular van that left for the station without two-tone and is held 45 s within 8 m by a stopped vehicle gets its trip re-issued once in urgency and says « Retenu par des véhicules à l'arrêt, je passe au deux-tons ». Found while diagnosing transfer.cellulaire « 30 minutes » under P23's temporary `parkBrake`: the full CELLULAIRE 1 stayed 15 minutes behind stopped civil cars, in the player's sight, and 0 detainees were delivered. On the current tree the 30-minute scenario delivers 16 detainees to the station, 4 aboard.
- **New test** in `transfer.cellulaire.test.ts`: urgent at t+46 s, two-tone at t+58 s, announced at t+76 s, first blocking car cleared at t+68 s.

`tsc` is clean. No P22 probe file is left.

Reds in passes A, B, C: playtest.commissariats « retour sous les yeux du joueur — 9e » and session.cellulaires « journée de service : les fourgons cellulaires partent avec la colonne ». Pass B adds police.convoi-ordre-joueur « journée de service du commandant … tout le monde à pied ». The 5 P22 cases and all of `transfer.cellulaire` (5/5) are green in all three passes.

`npx tsc --noEmit -p .`: exit 0 at about 00:08 and again at about 00:36.

Scratch probes (`tests/unit/zz-p22-fiche`, `zz-p22-transfer`) were run for diagnosis and deleted. No browser scenario was run; the package asks for none.
deviations: Plan §5.5 says the van drives to the station with `urgence:false`. It still leaves that way, but `pushThrough` re-issues the trip once in urgency after 45 s held by a stopped vehicle. The re-issue uses `cmd.arrive(..., boardFirst:true, stagger:true, urgence:true)`, the same call shape as `commissariats/system.ts relaunchMotos`; a direct re-issue with `boardFirst:false` stayed non-urgent for 110 s in my probe. Side effect: the convoy also says its usual « Embarquez, départ en colonne » on the radio.

Nasse seeds 23 and 5: the plan offered two designs (van to 20 m behind the line, or free the pair sooner). Neither was needed. The van was already sent to that rendezvous; a false stall detection stopped it at 160 m. Only that detection was fixed (previous agent's change, kept).

T5: the walking approach after a flight (`CHASE_FLEE`, `CHASE_SLOW`, `CHASE_CALM` and `ArrestExtra.fled` in `ops-arrest.ts`) is a mechanism not in the plan text (previous agent's draft, kept after verification).

`tests/unit/ui-command.envoi-fiche.test.ts`: `core.maps.scene.invalidate()` added before `ensureFresh()` inside the wait loop (previous agent's change, kept). No assertion, bound or exit condition was changed.
Edits outside the P22 file list, both small and logged in `coordination-etape5.md` by the previous agent: `special.ts startEmbark` (one guard and one import) and `system.ts drive` (one condition).

The new transfer test asserts the switch to urgency, the two-tone, the radio line and the first blocking car cleared. It does not assert that the van gets through the wall of driverless hand-braked cars: in that artificial case the convoy and engins rules (P23's files) clear cars slowly, and one probe run lost urgency again at t+231 s. The full trip in real traffic is covered by the existing « 30 minutes » test, where `pushThrough` fires for both vans and delivered ≥ 8 holds.
Bisecting priority 1 with a scratch copy was not redone: the previous agent's bisect is recorded in the coordination file and the case is green in all seven runs.
openIssues: Two cases of the P22 guard batch are red on the current tree: `playtest.commissariats` « retour sous les yeux du joueur — 9e : chaque véhicule se gare lui-même dans les places » (expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []) and `session.cellulaires` « journée de service : les fourgons cellulaires partent avec la colonne … » (point de remise null). Both were green three times between 23:32 and 23:52 and are red since P23's edits of 23:58–00:32 (`autopilot.ts`, `autopilot-state.ts`, `pathfind.ts`, `contracts.ts`, `bravm.ts`, `journee.ts`), with and without `pushThrough`. P23 was still editing when I stopped; re-run the P22 guard batch once P23 is finished.

`police.convoi-ordre-joueur` « journée de service du commandant … tout le monde à pied » (P23's batch) was red at 00:18–00:25 and green at 23:45–23:52. It does not load the transfer module and the `withDetainee` guards were already in at 23:45, so I attribute it to P23's later edits; I did not verify further.

`ui-command.envoi-fiche` nasse stays fragile against any change in how vehicles sit at Concorde. It went red under P20's idle handbrake hold (21:29–22:21) and again under P23's `parkBrake` (23:42–23:56), and is green without them. In my probe « Encercler (nasse) » on the marching cortège gave a street to each two-agent BRAV-M pair as well as to the sections, the crowd's exits moved with its head, and at most 1–2 exits were held, briefly. If a handbrake hold comes back, this case will flip again; the cause is in `ui/command` unit selection and the moving-crowd exits, outside P22's files.

`convoy.ts arrive()` (P23's file, not edited): the direct start without `boardFirst` calls `ap.convoy(...)` without `...this.pace(c)`, so a column started that way never drives with `urgence:true` at the autopilot level. Reported in the coordination file.

In the « 30 minutes » scenario on the current tree both departing vans are held more than 45 s by stopped civil cars and need `pushThrough` (radio at 705 s and 1402 s). The traffic stops for the player standing on the roadway beside the vans, then the motorists pull over across the lane. The point de remise sits on a street open to traffic; closing or thinning traffic there would be the deeper fix and was not attempted.

`engins.ts backoffStep` (P23's file) can resume a vehicle without urgency after backing off; this is already in P21's open issues. In the wall-of-cars probe the van lost its urgency again at t+231 s; `pushThrough` fires only once per trip by design.
P23's probe files (`tests/unit/zz-p23-*.test.ts`) are in the tree; they are not mine and I left them.
No browser scenario was run for the new radio line or the two-tone; headless tests only.
